title: Can You Score 80% On This Car Mechanic Quiz?
summary: Read the dashboard, connect vehicle systems and put your workshop reasoning to the test.

landing.intro:
Know your way around a car?
Put your skills to the test.

about.body:
Explore vehicle systems, warning signs, measurement and fault-finding through a mix of practical questions. Each set focuses on a new part of the car or a new kind of clue.

Choose the answer supported by the information shown. See your topic profile at each checkpoint, then reveal your overall result and optionally review missed answers.

Questions avoid national road rules, inspection standards and assumptions about one make or model. Diagnostic clues suggest areas to investigate; they do not prove a fault without testing. Vehicles differ, so manufacturer guidance matters.

steps: Read the clues and choose one answer.
See your topic profile at each checkpoint and continue to a new challenge.
Reveal your overall result, then optionally review the answers you missed.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment and general learning only. This quiz is not a professional qualification or vehicle-repair diagnosis. Vehicles differ; consult the manufacturer’s guidance and a qualified technician.

score.disclaimer: For entertainment and general learning only. This score is not a professional qualification, a vehicle safety inspection or repair advice.

mechanic-s1q1.question: An oil-can warning light is commonly associated with which engine problem?

mechanic-s1q2.question: What does ABS stand for on a car dashboard?

mechanic-s1q3.question: In a conventional fuel-powered car, a battery-shaped warning stays on while the engine runs. Which system needs checking?

mechanic-s1q4.question: A thermometer symbol above wavy lines commonly warns about what?

mechanic-s1q5.question: A dashboard message says “Power steering assist fault.” Which task may become harder?

mechanic-s1q6.question: Some warning lights turn on briefly at startup, then go out as the manual describes. What can this be?

answers.a1: A normal system or lamp check
answers.a2: Proof that every system is fault-free
answers.a3: A reminder to replace every sensor
answers.a4: A sign that the lights are disconnected

mechanic-s1q7.question: Where should you check the meaning of an unfamiliar dashboard symbol?

mechanic-s2q1.question: What is the main job of an engine air filter?

answers.a2: Trap particles before air enters the engine

mechanic-s2q2.question: In a petrol (gasoline) engine, what normally ignites the air-fuel mixture?

mechanic-s2q3.question: What is the main job of a fuel injector?

answers.a2: Deliver a controlled amount of fuel

mechanic-s2q4.question: Which moving part travels up and down inside an engine cylinder?

mechanic-s2q5.question: What does the crankshaft convert piston movement into?

mechanic-s2q6.question: What does a camshaft typically control?

answers.a1: The opening and closing of engine valves

mechanic-s2q7.question: What does a turbocharger use to drive its turbine?

mechanic-s3q1.question: In a disc brake, what do the brake pads press against to slow the wheel?

mechanic-s3q2.question: Which statement about ABS is accurate?

answers.a1: It replaces the need for tire grip
answers.a2: It guarantees the shortest stop on every surface
answers.a3: It makes worn brake pads work like new ones
answers.a4: It helps prevent wheel lock but cannot guarantee a shorter stop on every surface

mechanic-s3q3.question: A test car specifies 220 kPa for all four cold tires. Readings are 220, 220, 180 and 220 kPa. Which reading is below the stated target?

mechanic-s3q4.question: Which component squeezes the pads against a brake disc (rotor)?

mechanic-s3q5.question: What does friction braking mainly turn the car’s motion energy into?

mechanic-s3q6.question: What helps a road tire’s tread move water away from its contact area?

mechanic-s3q7.question: For a particular vehicle, which source gives the recommended tire pressures?

answers.a4: Its pressure placard or owner manual

mechanic-s4q1.question: In a conventional car with a running engine, what is the alternator mainly doing?

answers.a1: Turning the engine before it starts
answers.a3: Supplying electrical power and charging the battery

mechanic-s4q2.question: Which statement about electric cars is accurate?

answers.a1: Many have a separate low-voltage battery as well as the main drive battery
answers.a2: Electric cars cannot have low-voltage battery faults
answers.a3: All electrical parts connect directly to the main drive battery
answers.a4: A charged drive battery proves every electrical system is healthy

mechanic-s4q3.question: What is the starter motor’s main job in a conventional combustion car?

answers.a2: Turn the engine to begin starting it

mechanic-s4q4.question: What is the purpose of a fuse in an electrical circuit?

mechanic-s4q5.question: Which quantity is measured in volts?

mechanic-s4q6.question: Which quantity is measured in amperes?

mechanic-s4q7.question: What does an open circuit prevent along the broken path?

mechanic-s5q1.question: What does a thermostat normally regulate in an engine cooling system?

answers.a4: Coolant flow to help control engine temperature

mechanic-s5q2.question: Which statement about engine oil is accurate?

answers.a1: Thicker oil is best for every engine
answers.a2: Oil never needs changing if its level stays full
answers.a3: All oils with the same colour are identical
answers.a4: The specified grade matters; thicker is not always better

mechanic-s5q3.question: Which is the reliable way to choose a compatible engine coolant?

answers.a1: Follow the vehicle manufacturer’s coolant specification
answers.a2: Assume all products marked coolant are interchangeable
answers.a4: Match its colour and ignore the specification

mechanic-s5q4.question: What is the main purpose of engine oil?

mechanic-s5q5.question: What does the radiator help transfer from coolant to surrounding air?

mechanic-s5q6.question: What typically circulates coolant through a liquid-cooled engine?

mechanic-s5q7.question: Why should a hot pressurised cooling-system cap stay closed?

answers.a1: Hot liquid and steam can escape and burn
answers.a2: The coolant becomes harmless when hot
answers.a3: Removing it switches off all pressure instantly

mechanic-s6q1.question: Why does a conventional differential allow the driven wheels to turn at different speeds?

answers.a1: They must always turn in opposite directions
answers.a2: They travel different distances when cornering
answers.a3: One wheel must stop whenever the car turns
answers.a4: It prevents all wheel slip on every surface

mechanic-s6q2.question: Which statement separates wheel balancing from wheel alignment?

answers.a1: Both are names for the same adjustment
answers.a2: Balancing corrects weight imbalance; alignment adjusts wheel angles
answers.a3: Neither can affect how the car feels on the road
answers.a4: Balancing changes wheel angles; alignment adds wheel weights

mechanic-s6q3.question: In a manual transmission, what does the clutch allow you to disconnect?

answers.a2: The engine from the transmission input
answers.a4: The brake pads from their material

mechanic-s6q4.question: What is the main purpose of a gearbox?

answers.a1: Provide different speed and torque ratios

mechanic-s6q5.question: What do suspension dampers mainly control?

mechanic-s6q6.question: What does a wheel bearing allow?

answers.a2: The brake fluid to become compressible
answers.a3: The wheel to rotate while supporting load

mechanic-s6q7.question: What allows a driven front wheel to receive power while steering?

mechanic-s7q1.question: A test car uses 18 L of fuel over 300 km. At the same rate, how much would it use over 100 km?

mechanic-s7q2.question: A training example needs 4 L of a mixture containing 50% coolant concentrate by volume. How much concentrate is that?

mechanic-s7q3.question: A gearbox has a 3:1 reduction ratio. If the input turns at 1,200 rpm, what is the output speed?

mechanic-s7q4.question: The stated minimum thickness for a test component is 3.0 mm. It measures 2.5 mm. What does the measurement establish?

answers.a2: It is below the stated minimum
answers.a3: The measuring tool must be faulty
answers.a4: The component is exactly new thickness

mechanic-s7q5.question: A test component measures 8.0 mm, then 7.6 mm. What is the decrease?

mechanic-s7q6.question: A training diagram has 4 wheels with 5 fasteners each. How many fasteners?

mechanic-s7q7.question: A supplied test range is 10–14 units. Which reading is inside the range?

mechanic-s8q1.question: Two identical lamps share a power supply. One works and one does not. Which conclusion is supported by that fact alone?

answers.a1: The unlit bulb must be broken
answers.a2: The supply is not completely dead
answers.a3: The working lamp has a short circuit

mechanic-s8q2.question: A diagnostic scan reports a sensor-circuit fault. What does that establish?

answers.a1: The circuit needs diagnosis; the sensor is not automatically the cause
answers.a2: The sensor must always be replaced
answers.a3: Clearing the code permanently repairs the fault
answers.a4: The wiring has already passed every test

mechanic-s8q3.question: A noise started just after a repair. What is a useful first piece of information?

mechanic-s8q4.question: A fault occurs only when a connector is moved during a controlled test. What deserves checking?

mechanic-s8q5.question: Why compare a test reading with the specification for that vehicle?

answers.a1: A normal value can depend on the design

mechanic-s8q6.question: What does clearing a fault code establish by itself?

mechanic-s8q7.question: A symptom disappears once and later returns. What is the careful conclusion?

mechanic-s9q1.question: A car is supported only by a portable jack. Someone is about to work underneath it. What is the safe decision?

answers.a1: Go underneath if the job will take less than a minute
answers.a2: Go underneath if another person holds the jack handle
answers.a3: Go underneath if the engine is switched off
answers.a4: Do not go underneath until it is correctly supported with suitable equipment

mechanic-s9q2.question: A car suddenly pulls strongly to one side when braking. What is the safest next step?

answers.a1: Assume it is harmless if no warning light appears
answers.a2: Use higher speed to compare the braking
answers.a3: Keep driving until the pull disappears
answers.a4: Stop safely and arrange a professional inspection

mechanic-s9q3.question: Which tool is designed to tighten a fastener to a specified torque?

mechanic-s9q4.question: An unfamiliar electric-vehicle high-voltage system needs work. Who should handle it?

answers.a2: A qualified technician using the correct procedures
answers.a3: Anyone who has switched off the radio
answers.a4: An untrained person with a household screwdriver

mechanic-s9q5.question: Why can running a combustion engine in an enclosed space be dangerous?

answers.a2: The steering uses up the room’s light
answers.a3: Exhaust can contain poisonous carbon monoxide
answers.a4: The tires absorb all the oxygen

mechanic-s9q6.question: A tool is visibly damaged before use. What is the safe choice?

answers.a1: Use it harder to test it
answers.a3: Take it out of use and arrange a suitable replacement
answers.a4: Assume a short job makes it safe

mechanic-s9q7.question: Why follow the specified tightening torque?

answers.a1: Torque is only a colour code
answers.a2: Too little or too much can cause problems

mechanic-s10q1.question: A trained technician moves an ignition coil to another cylinder during diagnosis. The misfire moves with it. Which suspect does this most strongly support?

mechanic-s10q2.question: A new battery repeatedly loses charge, and the charging warning appears while the engine runs. What should be investigated?

answers.a1: The charging system and its connections
answers.a3: Only the age of the new battery

mechanic-s10q3.question: An engine overheats at idle but cools at road speed. During a technician’s test, the cooling fan is commanded on but does not run. What should be checked first?

answers.a4: The fan motor, power supply and control circuit

mechanic-s10q4.question: A steering-wheel vibration is strongest within one road-speed range. Which is a sensible early check, not a confirmed diagnosis?

answers.a1: Wheel and tire condition and balance

mechanic-s10q5.question: A device works with a tested power supply but not its original supply. Which area is implicated?

mechanic-s10q6.question: A service sheet specifies 5.0 L total. A training record shows 4.2 L. What is the difference?

mechanic-s10q7.question: Several parts could explain a symptom. Which approach best avoids replacing parts by guesswork?

answers.a1: Replace the most expensive part first
answers.a2: Treat the first suggestion as proof
answers.a3: Use targeted tests to compare the possible causes
answers.a4: Ignore the symptom if the paint looks good
